firstPlayerRule: Whoever can hold their breath the longest goes first.
houseFallback: If the comparison is unclear or your group prefers to skip it, agree to choose randomly. This is this site’s suggested house rule.
clarifications: Turns proceed clockwise from that player, with Playing Cards, Feeding, Aging, and Drawing Cards phases.
Assign Bonus Tokens by turn order: 4/0 points with two players, 6/4/0 with three, or 7/6/4/0 with four. Keep each token behind its owner’s screen for final scoring.
The trait-card and Alaska fishing-job tie-breaks concern the final score, not the starting player.
